composition_subtypes.role: Sort players by decreasing strength on each map to enable threshold-based expansion
Simultaneously advance pointers to update minimum required strengths in amortized O(n)

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort players by each map strength, then expand winning candidates via two-pointer threshold updates.
payload.rationale: Sorting provides ordered access; two-pointer loop efficiently propagates thresholds by advancing indices monotonically.
